sentences.text:
?Court No. - 28
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 566 of 2006

Revisionist :- Gokul Prasad
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- Bajrang Bahadur Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate
Hon'ble Virendra Kumar-II,J.

The C.J.M., Sultanpur vide letter dated 14.09.2019 has reported that he has recorded statements of
witnesses, daughter-in-law of the deceased, Gomti Devi, grand son-Rajan Kasodhan, process server
S.I. GauravAwasthi and Village Head, Sanno, who have apprised that revisionist-Gokul Prasad has
expired 3-4 years ago.

The revisionist has assailed the impugned judgment and order dated 12.10.2006 delivered by the revisional court/ Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.3, Sultanpur in Criminal Appeal No. 2 of 2005, arising out of judgment passed by the trial court in Case No. 2386 of 1992, State Vs. Gokul Prasad, under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.3, Sultanpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned trial court has convicted the revisionist vide judgment and order dated 13.01.2005.
The revisionist has preferred Criminal Appeal No. 2 of 2005, Gokul Prasad Vs. State before the Additional sessions Judge, Court No.3, Sultanpur, which was decided vide order dated 12.10.2006.

entities.text: Additional sessions Judge, Court No.3, Sultanpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned trial court has dismissed the appeal.
He was convicted and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for six months and a fine of amount of Rs.1,000/- was imposed with default stipulation.
Now the revisionist has expired 3-4 years ago, therefore, this revision is accordingly dismissed as abated.
